confidence_scope: Conditional on the declared passive physical class, mass/energy/convexity bounds, calibrated control and metrology inequalities, and reliable finite classical arithmetic.

physical_resources.calibration_contract: Drive error includes residual released-trap force, support-motion error, and any drag-calibration contribution during deployment. Acquisition calibration errors must separately meet the recorded deterministic report and initialization allowances.
physical_resources.frontend_force_range_contract: The force transducer must remain linear over the declared global force cap or have a certified clearing response; the finite ADC receipt prices the metered hold windows.

execution_scope.physical_plant: floating simulation, not laboratory or interval-validated ODE
execution_scope.raw_sensor_record: finite counts and digitization costs charged; fine bins aggregated, not individually materialized
execution_scope.learned_model: finite rational positive model independently verified
execution_scope.digital_predictor: actual rational path independently verified from saved knots
execution_scope.drive_error: robust allowance, not a sampled perturbed drive

preservation: No earlier accepted result is weakened or generalized by this construction.
